Name: Vessel of Ruin
Effect: Reduce by 2 the Special of everyone in the field, except this Pokémon. This Pokémon is immune to the effects of the Abilities: Beads of Ruin, Sword of Ruin, Tablets of Ruin, and Vessel of Ruin. Unique Ability.
Description: There is a cursed artifact on this Pokémon. A dreadful tremor of fear invades everyone. This Pokémon loves to terrorize and frighten others.
